title: switching agents should be immediate and then load content in, rather than right now it waits to switch until condent i…
summary: I've written the plan. The switch waits because the UI only sends `SelectAgent` and changes nothing on screen until the session replies with `SetActiveAgent`. The session sends that only after opening the agent's session, which runs synchronously, and then reads the history from the store. It also reloads chats the UI already has in memory.
